setup-worktree-windows: if (Test-Path "$env:ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/graft") { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force graft | Out-Null; Copy-Item "$env:ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/graft/*" graft -Recurse -Force }
setup-worktree-unix: if [ -d "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/graft" ]; then mkdir -p graft && cp -R "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/graft/." graft/; fi
